name: @navon/companion-web
description: Web companion app for Navon bike navigation. Mirrors iOS companion features minus device/BLE, using OSM tiles.

scripts.dev: VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") VITE_APP_GIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) VITE_APP_GIT_TIME=$(git log -1 --format=%cd) vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
scripts.build: VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") VITE_APP_GIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) VITE_APP_GIT_TIME=$(git log -1 --format=%cd) vite build
scripts.preview: VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") VITE_APP_GIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) VITE_APP_GIT_TIME=$(git log -1 --format=%cd) vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
